title: Late barge-in on the agent's goodbye

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Thanks for calling. How can I help you today?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Hi, a quick one: can changes to something I set up with you be made over the phone?

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Yes, they can. Any change can be made right here over the phone, and it takes effect straight away.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Great. That is all I needed, thanks. Bye.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: You're very welcome. Thanks for calling, and have a lovely rest of your day. Goodbye.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Oh wait, sorry, one more thing before you go.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Is there a way to get a confirmation of any change in writing?

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Yes. Every change comes with a written confirmation, sent by email or by text message, whichever you prefer.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Okay, that's all I needed. Thanks, bye.
